'''Raven's Peak sky train''' was a type of suspended [[train]] utilized by the [[Galactic Empire]] to service [[Raven's Peak]] on the [[planet]] [[Eriadu]]. It consisted of two-floor twin-car passenger trains that could seat at least five passengers in each car and moved along a [[Raven's Peak Sky Rail|suspended rail line]] that connected the remote fortress with the lower hills. It had caged windows and a reinforced [[hull]] to protect its passengers from [[blaster]] fire.<ref name="The Summit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Raven's Peak sky train first appeared in the fifteenth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', "[[The Summit]]." It later appeared in the sixteenth and final episode of the season, "[[Plan 99 (episode)|Plan 99]]." Both episodes premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[March 29]], [[2023]].<ref name="The Summit">{{TBB|The Summit}}</ref><ref name="Plan 99">{{TBB|Plan 99 (episode)}}</ref>
